segments.text:
Also the reprobate may haue a loue of God: but this loue can be no sincere loue, for it is only because God bestoweth benefits and prosperitie vpon him: as appeareth in Saul, who loued God for his aduancement to the kingdome: & here is a difference betweene the Elect and reprobate: the Elect loue God, as children their fathers: but reprobates, as hirelings their masters, whom they
affect not so much for themselues, as for their wages.
